statements.says: RWA Sonar's older catalogue describes USTBL as Eurozone sovereign debt and an older attestation row names Anchorage Digital as custodian with no source link; the September 2026 prospectus gives a US Treasury mandate and CACEIS Bank as depositary, and this restatement follows the prospectus.

outside.says: Shareholders through Spiko's dealing workflow: orders by 11:30 Paris time on eligible business days at the next NAV, paid by bank transfer or eligible currency-matched stablecoins; stablecoin settlement may be refused or suspended. No prospectus subscription or redemption commission; the investor bears chain costs.
Net redemptions above 10% can trigger gates; deferred orders are irrevocable. Stays in the prospectus.
The articles describe liquidation (p. 79); depositary-loss remedies and continuity without Spiko are left to the prospectus and French law.
The official NAV is defined in Spiko's NAV docs and distributed through listed oracle and data providers.

verdict.summary: This is the closest of the funds to a clean fit: the token is the register entry, the prospectus names the depositary and the administrator, and the issuer says the DLT register is the record of title. Saying that register prevails needs the authoritative-record proposal, the share needs a registered-holding kind and fund units, and the token is an Ethereum contract. CACEIS, the auditor and the AMF publish nothing in their own name in the sources.
